translation.name: Dillꞌ wen dillꞌ   Kob C̱he   Jesucrístonaꞌ

content: Bseḻ'gake' Páblona' yell Rómana'

Na'ch ka bc̱hoglall'gake' wseḻ'gake' neto' Itáliana' ḻoo barkwlə, bengake' Páblona' kon sto c̱hop pres yoblə lo na' beena' le Julio, nake' x̱an to guiyoa soldadka' beṉ'ka' nzi' soldad c̱he beena' chṉabia' Rómana'.
Na'ch wyoonto' to ḻoo barkw dii za' yell Adramítiona' na' zejan Ásiana'. Na' wza'len to beṉ' le Aristarco neto'. Nake' beṉ' Tesalónica, daa llia gana' mbani Macedóniana'.
Na' betiyo bllinnto' yell Sidónna', na' Júliona' ḻe wen benile' Páblona' na' bi'e latj jawie' beṉ'ka' nombi'e yella' kwenc̱he be'gake'ne' bi dii byalljile'.
Na' ka biza'nto' Sidonna' na' wdeteznto' yic̱hjlə yell-lio Chíprena' daa llia lo nisdo'na' kwenc̱he bkweejan neto' daa ḻe ze be'na'.
Na' wdetento' lo nisdo'na' daa de tcho'a yell-lio gana' mbani Cilíciana' na' Panfíliana', na' bllinnto' cho'a yell Mírana', daa llia gana' mbani Líciana'.
Na' yell Mírana' x̱an soldadka' bllelile' to barkw dii za' Alejandríana' na' zejan Itáliana', na' bidie' neto' ḻo'inna'.
Na' zan lla wyajlennto' barkwa' sho'lall'zə, na' kaṉi bllinnto' cho'a yell Gnídona'. Na' daa ze be'na' klelə, na' wyec̱hjnto' yell-lio Crétana' daa llia lo nisdo'na', wdeteznto' cho'a yell Salmónna'.
Na' kaṉi gok zejnto' tcho'a nisdo'na' ax̱t ni bllintento' gana' le Buenos Puertos, gaozə yell Laseana'.
Zan llate ba wllainto' na' ba chonan dii nxoll shajchnto' lo nisdo'na' daa ba zoa yiḻen dii zaga'. Na' goll Páblona' ḻegake':
―Chakbe'id' shi shajchcho nxoll kwiayi' barkwi na' kwiayi'te yoa'na' nsa'n, na' aga toz diiki san lenkzcho ḻe nxoll kwiayi'cho.
Per na' x̱an soldadka', bzenagche' c̱he beena' chsa' barkwa' na' c̱he x̱aninna', na' bi bzenague' daa goll Páblona' ḻegake'.

Na' daa bi nak latja' wen yigaaṉnto' na'z shlak chi' dii zaga', zangake' bc̱hoglall'gake' shajchnto' kwenc̱he illinnto' yell Fenícena' gana' yigaaṉnto' shlak te dii zaga'. Nakan to latj ga mbani Crétana', gana' choo barkwka', na' bitek choon be'na' daa za' cha'lə ni daa za' lli'lə.
Wze to be' wal lo nisdo'na'
Na'ch wzolo ze to be'ḻes dii za' lli'lə, na' beṉ'ka' chsa' barkwa' gokgakile' wakkzə shajgake'. Na'ch wdegake' tcho'azi yell-lio c̱he Crétana' daa llia lo nisdo'na'.
Ka gok shloll, wzolo to be' wal dii za' cha'lə.
Na'ch wzolon chlligaan barkwa' na' bikzə bi gok gonnto', na' bsanlall'choklənto'n nllig' be'na' ḻen.
Na' ka wdento' gaozə to yell-liodo' le Clauda daa llia lo nisdo'na', na' bich zetek be'na'. Na'ch barkwdo'na' ngoyo barkw xenna' biḻepnto'n ḻoo barkw xenna', per kaṉi gokan.

Na' ka biyoll biḻepnto'n, na'ch bc̱hejgake' barkw xenna' rietka' kwenc̱he goklenan daa. Na' daa bllebgake' lljshia barkwa' lo yoxa' latja' le Sirte, na' bitobgake' lech'ka' daa chonan ka chza' barkwa' na' be'gake' latj bllig' be'na' barkwa' kwenc̱he shajan kon ga wlliga'n ḻen.
Na' betiyo, daa zizikli wzech be'na', na' wzologake' bsheshgake' yoa'na' nsa' barkwa' na' bzaḻ'gake'n ḻoo nisdo'na' kwenc̱he bichtek gok barkwa' zii.
Na' ka gok shoṉ lla, ax̱t len xshinḻaz barkwa' bzaḻ'nto' ḻoo nisdo'na'.
Na' zan lla bi bli'lao wbilla' ni beljka', na' daa zechga be'na', bich bennto' lez yilanto'.

Na' ka ba gok zan lla biṉ' gaonto', na'ch Páblona' wzie' ladj beṉ'ka' na' chi'e ḻegake': ―Sheḻ' bzenagle c̱ha' kana' zoacho Crétana', ka wnia' le' bich shajcho, aga bi bṉitcho ni bi zoacho dii nxoll, sheḻ'ka'.
Na' ṉaa bikzə gonc̱hoplall'zle, ḻa' ni tole bi guet. Toz barkwi kwiayi'.
Ḻa' daa nlle'yi Chios c̱ha'na' beena' chonḻilallaa bseḻee to anjl bli'lawe' nad'.
Na' anjla' wne' nad': “Bi illebo' Pablo. Chonan byen illino' lao beṉ' wṉabia' Césara', na' ni c̱ho' li' yiyesh'lallii Chioza' yog' beṉ'ka' zejleno' txen ḻoo barkwi na' bi guetgake'.”
Na' ṉaa, ḻi wtiplall'le, ḻa' nx̱enilallaa Chioza' na' ṉezyeṉid' kon ka wna anjla' nad' kayeṉ'nan gak.
Per chonan byen wwiacho naklə goncho kwenc̱he yichooṉan cho' to lo yell-liodo' dii llia lo nisdo'ni.

Na' ba gok shda' wbill ka bllinnto' gana' de Nisdo' Adriáticona', na' ni chllig' be'na' barkwa' to ki to ka'lə lo nisdo'na'. Na' ka bllin chel, beṉ'ka' chsa' barkwa' gokbe'gakile' ba chllinnto' gana' de yo billa'.
Na'ch bḻetjgake' to ya kwenc̱he bchix̱gake' ka'k' zitj nisa', na' ka bchix̱gake'n zitjan shin'toyichoa metr. Na'ch ka wza'n zilat' na'ch bizchix̱gake'n dii yoblə na' zitjan gallichoa metr.
Na' daa bllebgake' lljsho' barkwa' ḻee yajka', bḻetjgake' tap ya xen dii llia xoziin kwenc̱he kwe' barkwa' tozga, sheḻ' wxegakile' lii sheeni'te.
Na' beṉ'ka' chsa' barkwa' gokgakile' yixoṉjgake'. Na'ch wzologake' chḻetjgake' barkwdo'na' daa yoo ḻoo barkw xenna', chontezgake' ka chḻetj sto ya xen c̱he barkwa'.
Na'ch Páblona' golle' x̱an soldadka' na' soldad c̱he'ka': ―Shi beṉ'ki bich yigaaṉgake' ḻoo barkwi, aga wilalat'le shi ṉaa.
Na'ch soldadka' bc̱hoggake' rietka' daa nchej barkwdo'na' na' bxopan ḻoo nisa'.
Na' ka ba zoa sheeni' Páblona' golle' ḻegake': ―Ḻi gaolat'. Ba gok shda' wbill bi chaole daa chall chlleble.
Na' nia' chonan byen gaolat'le kwenc̱he yiyakshao'lall'le, ḻa' ni tole bi kwiayi'.
Na' ka biyoll wna Páblona' ka', na' bex̱ee to yetxtil na' bi'e Chioza' yeḻ' chox̱ken lao beṉ'ka' lene' na' bxoxje'n na' wzoloe' chawe'.
Na' ka ble'gakile' chawe', na'ch yoguee bendiplall'gake' wdaogake'.
Yog'ḻoḻ neto' yoonto' ḻoo barkwa' naknto' c̱hop guiyoa guiyonshin'to.
Na' ka beljgakile', na'ch bzaḻ'gake' trígona' daa nsa' barkwa' ḻoo nisa' kwenc̱he bich goktek barkwa' zii.
Wche' barkwa' yel

Na' ka wyeeni', beṉ'ka' chsa' barkwa' aga biyombia'gake' yell-liona', per ble'gakile' to ladj lc̱hi ga choo xoz' nisa' gana' gokgakile' wak sho' barkw c̱he'ka'. Na' bc̱hoglall'gake' lljḻekwgake'n lo yoxa'.

Na' bc̱hoggake' riet c̱he ya xenka' daa chzagaan barkwa' na' wchooṉlall'gake'n ḻoo nisa'. Na'ch bisellgake' yaga' daa chaklenan chzec̱hj chlliin barkwa', na' bizeshgake' lechaa daa ze yic̱hjinna' kwenc̱he bllig' be'na'n, na' wzolo barkwa' zjabigaan cho'a nisa'.
Na' jshia xin' barkwa' to ga zoayaa yoxa' ḻoo nisdo'na' na' gogaan, na' aga gokch yichejan. Na'ch bḻi c̱he nisdo'na' wzolon bxoxj btinan xan barkwa'.
Na'ch soldadka' nan witgake' preska' kwenc̱he ni toe' bi x̱oa yela' lo nisa' na' yixoṉjgake'.
Per x̱ane'ka' bi bi'e latj witgake' ḻegake' daa goklallee yisle' Páblona'. Na' bene' mandad zigaate beṉ'ka' chak x̱oa yela' wxit'gake' ḻoo nisa' kwenc̱he yillingake' lo yo billa',
na' beṉ'ka' bi chak x̱oagake' yela' wc̱hingake' yagla'ka' wa diika' ba goxj c̱he barkwa' kwenc̱he gak yillingake' lo yona'. Na' ka' bennton', na' yog'ḻoḻnto' billinnto' shi'a shao' lo yo billa'.
